question: Where can I get the results of renewable and storage auctions in the United States, with awarded projects, capacity (MW), price, technology and location?

answer.summary: No federal renewable or storage auction or national award list was found; results are published state by state. Best structured source: NYSERDA open data (data.ny.gov dprp-55ye), one row per award with RFP code, technology, county/ZIP, contracted MW, REC strike price and status; NY bulk storage awards are in ugya-enpy (kW, address, no price). Illinois publishes an awards workbook plus ICC notices with average prices; New Jersey BPU orders give per-project prices; California lists utility contracts without price; Massachusetts prices sit in DPU dockets that block automated clients.
main_caveats: Selection, contract filing, approval and cancellation are separate stages: NY open data keeps 147 cancelled awards; MA 83E selected 1,268 MW but filed contracts for 1,118 MW; MA offshore wind rounds II-III were cancelled.
Prices are not comparable across mechanisms: NY Index vs Fixed REC, IL indexed REC/ISC strike (event average, $/MWh), NJ storage $/MW-year, DOE table mixing PPA and OREC levelized prices.
NY open data leaves the price blank for RESRFP24-1 and later awards until commercial operation; 83 of 326 rows carry no price.
Storage awards are published in MW of power; MWh is absent from NY bulk storage, IL and NJ award records and appears only in MA news and bids.
NYSERDA's website, the MA DPU fileroom, FERC and LBNL pages return 403 to automated clients; data.ny.gov, ICC/IPA, NJ BPU and CPUC files were reachable.
answer.confidence_reason: Five state programs tested with real records; other procuring states (CT, RI, ME, MD, VA, utility all-source RFPs) not checked; key NYSERDA and MA DPU pages blocked to automated clients.

attributes.note: Named projects tied to their RFP or event in NY, IL, NJ and MA; CA gives program and RAM round. State by state only; no national list.
MW per project; basis differs (NY contracted portion, IL/NJ AC nameplate, NY storage kW AC). Storage MWh is rarely in official award records.
NY REC strike per project (blank for RESRFP24-1+ until operation); NJ $/MW-year per project; IL only event averages in $/MWh.
attributes.gap_note: MA contract prices are in DPU dockets 26-87/88/89 (fileroom returns 403 to automated clients); CA terms confidential for 3 years; NY bulk storage price absent from open data.

attributes.note: Technology per project in every source checked (e.g., Land-based Wind, Solar, Hydroelectric, Lithium Ion, Utility-Scale Wind).
IL address or coordinates; CA lat/long; NY storage street address; NJ municipality; NY renewables county/ZIP only (point = ZIP centroid).
attributes.gap_note: No official site location found for MA awards on macleanenergy.com or mass.gov pages opened; NY dprp-55ye gives county and ZIP, not the site.

attributes.note: NY renewables through 2026-09-30 (RESRFP25-1); NY storage 2026-11-04; IL file 2026-10-30, IL storage notice 2026-09-01; CA file October 2026.
NY awards since 2004 incl. cancelled; IL awards since 2010 (LTPPA to Summer 2026); CA contracts incl. RAM rounds 1-7. Price mechanisms change between rounds.
Publisher-stated: NY renewables quarterly, NY storage and IL workbook monthly; IL notices per event (REC events twice a year); NJ, MA per solicitation.

Location is county/ZIP; the point is a ZIP centroid.

sources.name: State procurement award notices, regulator orders and contract filings
sources.publisher: State procurement bodies and utility regulators (Illinois Power Agency and Illinois Commerce Commission, New Jersey Board of Public Utilities, Massachusetts DOER with the distribution companies and DPU, NYSERDA)
sources.format: PDF notices and board orders; HTML notices
sources.summary: Official award notices and orders that name winners with MW and location, and give prices per event (IL averages in $/MWh) or per project (NJ $/MW-year); MA notices give selection and contract-filing stages.
sources.coverage_note: Choose the state: IL for indexed REC and storage events since 2017 (example used here: 2026-09-01 storage notice); NJ for BPU-ordered storage awards; MA for 83C/83E stages, with prices only in blocked DPU dockets.
caveats: IL prices are averages of indexed strike prices.
Precision varies: IL address or coordinates, NJ municipality, MA none.

members_summary.scope_note: 5 resources from 4 states opened (IL, NJ, MA, NY); IL and NJ tested to the award table, MA notices tested, MA DPU and NYSERDA site blocked. The number of US states running renewable or storage procurements was not established; others (e.g., CT, RI, ME, MD, VA) were not checked.
